description: This file manages the installation of the signal-cli tool, including fetching releases from GitHub, selecting appropriate assets based on platform and architecture, downloading, extracting, and installing via different methods (direct download, Homebrew). It also provides utility functions for archive detection and binary discovery.

methods.name: extractSignalCliArchive
methods.description: Extracts the signal-cli archive to a specified directory with a timeout.

methods.name: looksLikeArchive
methods.description: Checks if a filename looks like a supported archive format (.tar.gz, .tgz, .zip).

methods.name: pickAsset
methods.description: Selects the appropriate release asset based on platform and architecture.

methods.name: installSignalCli
methods.description: Main function to install signal-cli, choosing method based on platform and architecture.
